name: Self-Objecting Sponsor — Contradictory Rep Behaviour
description: rep_001 sponsors prop_001 but also objects to it at severity=6. The self-objection counts toward viability (dragging it down) AND triggers the supporter coherence rule (rep_001 excluded from supporters). prop_002 wins on viability.
trap_logic: Naive engine ignores self-objections as 'impossible'. Correct engine applies them: they reduce viability AND disqualify the sponsor as supporter.

scoring.full_credit: prop_002 ranked above prop_001, rep_001 absent from supporters
scoring.partial_credit: rep_001 excluded but wrong proposal ranking
scoring.zero: rep_001 included as supporter or self-objection ignored
